title: Full dynamic E3 response-space safeguarded outer coupling in one prepared solve

technical_history.repair: derive local contraction counts from persisted cumulative_contractions; no scientific gate changed

bounded_conclusions: The response-space bridge survives the complete first safeguarded update in one continuous prepared solve and reproduces the G17 outer-1 accepted head to floating-point precision.
The full dynamic path does not reproduce the preregistered G17 trajectory at outer 2: the accepted lambda=1 response differs by 7.215394948190124e-11 m, above the fixed 1e-12 m gate.
The outer-2 candidate remains participant status 0 and improves the coupling residual, so this is a path-equivalence failure rather than a basic admissibility or merit failure.
The G21 hypothesis is therefore falsified as preregistered. No tolerance, E3 rule, P4 rule, response damping rule or MODFLOW ownership rule is weakened.
G19 and G20 remain valid bounded bridge evidence; G21 shows that composing the bridge dynamically introduces a small but material trajectory divergence by the second outer update.
next_natural_unit: Open a diagnostic G21A to decompose the outer-2 divergence into tangent re-evaluation sensitivity, response-space algebra/reference-head sensitivity, and continuous prepared-solve path dependence. Do not change G21 gates.
